notes.title: Cozy Job Simulators - Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist & Susan's Potion Workshop ✨
notes.content:
Good day to you, Witches and Wizards[hr][/hr]
Do you have your ladles, vials, and cauldrons ready to go? We sure hope so, because today we step into the magical world of potion making, where every task is both engaging and wonderfully relaxing. Whether you’re carefully brewing mystical mixtures or experimenting with new recipes, your work as an aspiring witch takes place in a cozy, inviting environment with a gorgeous graphical style that brings the fairy-tale world to life.



[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//41780393/0cb9c499694787f66ca1c216b45cdd0a84474a08.png"]


Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist & Susan's Potion Workshop are part of Cozy Job Simulators 🌟[hr][/hr]
The Cozy Jobs Simulator Event brings together a collection of relaxing and heartwarming titles that let you hone your job skills in a calm, stress-free environment. If you love unwinding with games that make everyday tasks feel magical, this event is a great opportunity to expand your library with some truly delightful new titles.




Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist
In Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist, you can fulfill your dream of becoming a true witch with the power to create a wide variety of potions! What's more, in this cozy title you can enjoy visual novel elements, take care of your enchanted garden, and decorate your hut.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1798720/Nora_The_Wannabe_Alchemist/"][/dynamiclink]
[hr][/hr]

Susan's Potion Workshop
Step into Susan’s world and unleash your inner witch! In Susan’s Potion Workshop, you open a magical potion shop and get hands-on with bubbling cauldrons, colorful elixirs, and whimsical adventures. Have fun with a "match-3" gameplay where you mix, brew, and create potions with unique effects and dazzling designs.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661540/Susans_Potion_Workshop/"][/dynamiclink]



See you in the laboratory!
